Icons via Iconify Solar 'solar:*' set (posts-carousel-vertical-bold, arrow-right-linear, play-circle-bold, bolt-bold, hand-shake-bold, menu-dots-bold, alt-arrow-left-linear, alt-arrow-right-linear, bookmark-linear, cursor-bold, planet-bold, black-hole-bold, cardholder-bold, diploma-bold, atom-bold, magic-stick-3-bold, copy-bold, check-circle-bold, chart-2-bold, hand-stars-bold, full-screen-square-bold, smartphone-2-bold, accessibility-bold, code-square-bold) plus mdi:github / ri:twitter-x-fill / mdi:discord in the footer, loaded from https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js. Photos via Unsplash. The reusable prompt-library value is the FULLSCREEN STORY CAROUSEL pattern: a full-bleed phone-shaped story card with segmented progress bars across the top (one animating via a 5s fillbar keyframe, mapping to slide count), left/right tap-to-advance zones that reveal a circular arrow on hover, a story meta row (avatar + name + '2 of 5 . 4s'), and a bottom caption block (a chapter tag + title + sub line + a Continue/bookmark button row), all over layered navy gradients on the photo, plus a floating 'tap -> advance' accent card, wrapped into a complete one-screen cinematic 'Storyframe' landing (a sticky translucent navy nav, a two-column hero, a trust strip, a three-up full-bleed showcase gallery whose cards reuse the segmented-bars + tag + caption pattern, a full-bleed 'Prompt Library' section with a 'story-carousel.prompt' code card, a 6-up bordered 'Craft' feature grid, a full-bleed gradient CTA panel and a footer). Original prompt-library product for the placeholder brand 'Storyframe', a cinematic full-bleed Instagram/Stories-style story-carousel angle distinct from the warm multi-card 'Glide' sibling. Responsive: the hero grid stacks lg:grid-cols-2 -> one column, the story card scales w-[300px] -> sm:w-[340px] at a fixed 9/16 aspect (the floating accent card hidden below sm), the showcase gallery collapses lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column, the prompt-library lg:grid-cols-12 (5/7) -> one column, the craft grid lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column, the nav center links hide below md and 'Sign in' below sm, the headlines scale (hero text-[2.7rem] -> sm:text-6xl, sections text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl, CTA text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl), the CTA button row + footer switch flex-col -> sm:flex-row, the trust strip wraps, and the body is overflow-x-hidden so the blurred blobs never scroll; no horizontal overflow at 390px.

structured.summary: A cinematic, full-bleed fullscreen story carousel rendered as a complete one-screen 'Storyframe' landing on a deep-navy palette with a single amber accent and warm cream text. A sticky translucent navy nav sits over a two-column hero (LEFT: a 'FULLSCREEN STORY CAROUSEL . NEW PATTERN' pill eyebrow with a pulsing amber dot, a black 'Stories that tap forward.' headline whose 'tap forward.' is amber, a cream intro line, a 'Generate a story carousel' amber pill + a 'See it live' outlined button, and a two-item 'Copy-paste React + Tailwind' / 'Touch + keyboard ready' trust row; RIGHT: the hero centerpiece, a 9/16 phone-shaped story-card mock holding a full-bleed photo under layered navy gradients, a row of five segmented progress bars across the top, a story meta row (an 'SF' avatar + 'Storyframe' + '2 of 5 . 4s'), left/right tap-to-advance zones that reveal a circular arrow on hover, and a bottom caption block (a 'Chapter 02' amber tag, a 'The Golden Hour' title, a sub line, a cream 'Continue' button + a bookmark button), with a floating 'tap -> advance' accent card pinned to its lower-left). Below: a trust strip ('Shipped by teams at' + five icon logos), a 'Showcase' three-up gallery of full-bleed story cards each with its own segmented bars + category tag + caption, a full-bleed 'Prompt Library' section (a copy column beside a 'story-carousel.prompt' code card with a Copy button + tags + a rating chip), a 'Craft' 6-up bordered feature grid, a full-bleed gradient CTA panel, and a navy footer. Inter throughout, Iconify Solar 'solar:*' icons, immersive and cinematic, zero em-dashes.

style.description: A cinematic, immersive, premium-editorial aesthetic where a deep-navy ground, warm cream type and a single bright amber accent make the page feel like a film title sequence. The page sits on a deep navy #0b1f3a ground (a navy ramp: 900 #081627 darkest, 800 #0b1f3a base, 700 #122e54, 600 #1b3e6e) with warm cream text (cream #f6f1e3 default, soft #e9e1cc, dim #bcb4a0 muted) and a single amber accent (amber #f0b429 default, soft #f8cf67, deep #c98a12) reserved for the brand mark, the headline highlight, primary buttons, progress-bar fills, category tags and icon accents. Surfaces are softly oversized-rounded (the hero story card rounded-[2rem], showcase cards rounded-3xl, the prompt code card / craft tiles rounded-3xl, buttons fully rounded-full) and lit with custom layered shadows: .slide-shadow '0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(246,241,227,0.06)' (a deep cinematic drop + a faint cream hairline) on the story card / showcase cards / prompt card / floating accent card, and .glow-amber '0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.25), 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(240,180,41,0.35)' (an amber-ringed glow) on the primary CTAs. Typography is Inter at every weight (400..900), font-black for the big headlines with tight tracking, medium for nav/body. Signature cinematic touches: a faint SVG fractal-noise .grain texture (opacity ~0.04) over the hero and CTA; large soft blurred decorative color blobs (an amber/10 blur and a navy-600/40 blur on the hero, an amber/10 blur on the prompt section, a centered amber/12 blur on the CTA); the layered slide gradients on every photo (a vertical from-navy-900/95 via-navy-900/10 to-navy-900/40 + a horizontal from-navy-900/30 to-transparent) keeping cream captions legible over any image; an amber ::selection (background amber, navy-900 text). The story carousel is the hero centerpiece: five SEGMENTED PROGRESS BARS (flex-1 h-1 rounded-full, seg track rgba(246,241,227,0.22), seg-fill amber #f0b429) where one bar runs a .seg-anim @keyframes fillbar (transform-origin left, scaleX 0 -> 1) over 5s linear (respecting prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), and LEFT/RIGHT TAP-TO-ADVANCE ZONES (inset-y-0 w-1/3 zones, opacity-0 hover:opacity-100, a .tap-hint / .tap-hint-l amber-tinted directional gradient + a circular navy-900/50 backdrop-blur arrow button). Immersive, cinematic, premium; warm human copy with zero em-dashes.
style.prompt: Cinematic fullscreen story carousel / 'Storyframe' landing on a deep-navy palette with a single amber accent and warm cream text. Tailwind CDN with a custom theme.extend: fontFamily.sans ['Inter','sans-serif']; colors.navy { DEFAULT '#0b1f3a', 900 '#081627', 800 '#0b1f3a', 700 '#122e54', 600 '#1b3e6e' }, colors.cream { DEFAULT '#f6f1e3', soft '#e9e1cc', dim '#bcb4a0' }, colors.amber { DEFAULT '#f0b429', soft '#f8cf67', deep '#c98a12' }. Load Inter (weights 400;500;600;700;800;900) from Google Fonts and Iconify (https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js). CSS keys: html scroll-behavior smooth; body background #0b1f3a, color #f6f1e3, font-sans, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased, overflow-x-hidden. .grain { background-image an inline SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise (baseFrequency 0.9, numOctaves 3, opacity 0.5) } used at opacity ~0.04 for film grain. .glow-amber { box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.25), 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(240,180,41,0.35) }. .slide-shadow { box-shadow 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(246,241,227,0.06) }. .seg { background rgba(246,241,227,0.22) } and .seg-fill { background #f0b429 } are the progress-bar track + fill; .seg-anim { transform-origin left; animation fillbar 5s linear forwards } with @keyframes fillbar { from transform scaleX(0); to transform scaleX(1) }. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .seg-anim { animation none } * { scroll-behavior auto } }. .tap-hint { background linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11,31,58,0) 0%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10) 100%) } and .tap-hint-l { the 270deg mirror } tint the tap zones. ::selection { background #f0b429; color #081627 }. The headline is text-black tracking-tight (text-[2.7rem] leading-[1.05] sm:text-6xl) with 'tap forward.' in text-amber. Primary buttons are rounded-full bg-amber text-navy-900 (hover bg-amber-soft) with .glow-amber; the brand mark + category tags + progress fills + icon accents all use amber. The story card / showcase cards / prompt card use .slide-shadow over layered navy slide gradients (a vertical from-navy-900/95 via-navy-900/10 to-navy-900/40 + a horizontal from-navy-900/30 to-transparent). Photos via Unsplash. Icons via Iconify Solar 'solar:*' set (plus mdi:github / ri:twitter-x-fill / mdi:discord in the footer). Immersive, cinematic; warm human copy, zero em-dashes ('Stories that tap forward.', 'Ship the kind of cinematic onboarding people actually finish.', 'Details that earn the tap.').

layout_and_structure.description: A sticky translucent navy nav, then a two-column hero (LEFT a pill eyebrow + a font-black headline with an amber highlight + a cream intro + a two-button row + a two-item trust row; RIGHT the hero centerpiece, a 9/16 story-card mock with segmented progress bars, a story meta row, left/right tap zones and a bottom caption block, plus a floating 'tap -> advance' accent card), then a trust strip, then a 'Showcase' three-up full-bleed story-card gallery, then a full-bleed 'Prompt Library' two-column section (a copy column beside a 'story-carousel.prompt' code card), then a 'Craft' 6-up bordered feature grid, then a full-bleed gradient CTA panel, then a navy footer. Most containers center in mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8.

RIGHT: a hidden-below-sm 14px font-medium text-cream-dim 'Sign in' link + a rounded-full bg-amber text-navy-900 px-4 py-2 14px font-semibold 'Start free' button (hover bg-amber-soft, shadow-lg shadow-amber/20).

A relative overflow-hidden section with a .grain opacity-[0.04] overlay and two pointer-events-none blurred decorative blobs (an -top-40 -left-40 w-[34rem] h-[34rem] rounded-full bg-amber/10 blur-[120px], and a top-20 right-0 w-[28rem] h-[28rem] rounded-full bg-navy-600/40 blur-[120px]). Inner = mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 pt-16 pb-12 (lg:pt-24 lg:pb-20), a grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 (lg:gap-8) items-center. NEW PATTERN'; (2) a text-[2.7rem] leading-[1.05] (sm:text-6xl) font-black tracking-tight headline 'Stories that'
with 'tap forward.' in a text-amber span; (3) an mt-6 text-lg leading-relaxed text-cream-soft/80 intro paragraph; (4) an mt-9 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 button row: a primary group inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-amber text-navy-900 px-6 py-3.5 font-bold .glow-amber 'Generate a story carousel' anchor with a trailing solar:arrow-right-linear (group-hover:translate-x-1) + a secondary inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-cream/15 text-cream px-6 py-3.5 font-semibold 'See it live' anchor with a leading amber solar:play-circle-bold (hover border-cream/35 bg-cream/5); (5) an mt-10 flex items-center gap-6 text-sm text-cream-dim trust row: 'Copy-paste React + Tailwind' (amber solar:bolt-bold) + 'Touch + keyboard ready' (amber solar:hand-shake-bold).

(e) TAP ZONES = an absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/3 z-10 .tap-hint-l flex items-center pl-2 opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 transition zone holding a 36px (w-9 h-9) grid place-items-center rounded-full bg-navy-900/50 backdrop-blur text-cream solar:alt-arrow-left-linear, mirrored on the right (inset-y-0 right-0 w-1/3 .tap-hint justify-end pr-2, solar:alt-arrow-right-linear); Plus a floating accent card: a hidden sm:flex absolute -left-6 bottom-16 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-navy-800/90 backdrop-blur border border-cream/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 .slide-shadow card with an amber solar:cursor-bold + a 'tap -> advance' (text-xs font-semibold text-cream) label.

A #showcase section = relative mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 py-20 (lg:py-28). A max-w-2xl mb-12 header: a text-amber font-bold text-sm tracking-widest uppercase 'The Showcase' eyebrow, a text-3xl (sm:text-4xl) font-black tracking-tight 'Three stories, one pattern.' headline, an mt-4 text-cream-soft/70 text-lg intro line. Then a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of three group relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden .slide-shadow <article> cards, each = a full-bleed Unsplash photo (group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-700) under an absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-navy-900/95 via-transparent to-navy-900/20 gradient, with its own absolute top-4 left-4 right-4 flex gap-1.5 segmented progress bars (a mix of .seg-fill filled + .seg empty bars, varying counts per card 4/3/5), and a bottom-0 p-6 caption: an inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-extrabold tracking-widest uppercase category tag (bg-amber text-navy-900 'Travel' / bg-cream text-navy-900 'Product' / bg-amber text-navy-900 'Editorial'), a text-xl font-black title ('Coastline Escape' / 'Alpine Launch' / 'Into the Mist'), and a text-sm text-cream-soft/70 mt-1 sub line.

LEFT (lg:col-span-5): a text-amber font-bold text-sm tracking-widest uppercase 'Prompt Library' eyebrow, a text-3xl (sm:text-4xl) font-black tracking-tight leading-tight 'Describe the story.'
'We frame it.' headline, an mt-5 text-cream-soft/70 text-lg leading-relaxed intro, an mt-7 space-y-3.5 list of three flex items-start gap-3 rows each a 20px amber solar:check-circle-bold + a text-cream-soft/85 line ('Auto-advance timers with pause-on-hold' / 'Segmented bars that map to slide count' / 'Left / right tap zones, keyboard, and swipe'), and an mt-8 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-amber text-navy-900 px-6 py-3.5 font-bold .glow-amber 'Browse the library' anchor with a trailing solar:arrow-right-linear. RIGHT (lg:col-span-7): a rounded-3xl border border-cream/10 bg-navy-800/80 backdrop-blur overflow-hidden .slide-shadow code card: a header bar (flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-cream/10 bg-navy-900/40) with an amber solar:magic-stick-3-bold + a 'story-carousel.prompt' filename (font-semibold text-cream) on the left and a flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-navy-900 bg-amber px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full 'Copy prompt' button (solar:copy-bold, hover bg-amber-soft) on the right; a p-6 font-mono text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-cream-soft/90 body (a 'Build' amber-soft span + 'a fullscreen story carousel:' then pl-4 bullet lines: segmented progress bars / full-bleed image slide / left/right tap zones / auto-advance every '5s' (amber) pause on hold, then a 'Palette: deep navy, cream text, amber accent. Immersive, cinematic, Inter.' line with amber spans); and a px-6 pb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2 tag row of five pills: four rounded-full bg-cream/5 border border-cream/10 text-xs text-cream-dim tags '#story' / '#fullscreen' / '#tap-zones' / '#progress-bars' + a rounded-full bg-amber/15 border border-amber/30 text-xs text-amber-soft font-semibold 'star 4.9 . 12k uses' rating chip.

Stories that tap forward.' line + a 'Crafted for the prompt library.' line.

Most containers center in mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 (the CTA in max-w-3xl). The showcase gallery grid collapses lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column; the prompt-library section grid lg:grid-cols-12 (5/7 split) -> one column; the craft grid lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column. The nav center links hide below md, the 'Sign in' link below sm; the section headlines scale text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl (the CTA text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl). The hero button row is flex-wrap; the CTA button row and footer switch flex-col -> sm:flex-row (the footer top row md:flex-row). The trust strip wraps (flex-wrap). The body is overflow-x-hidden so the large blurred blobs never cause horizontal scroll; no horizontal overflow at 390px.

special_ui_components.prompt: Fullscreen story-card mock (the hero centerpiece): a w-[300px] sm:w-[340px] aspect-[9/16] rounded-[2rem] phone-shaped card with a full-bleed photo under layered navy slide gradients, segmented progress bars, a story meta row, tap zones and a bottom caption block, lifted on .slide-shadow

Segmented progress bars: a flex gap-1.5 row of five h-1 rounded-full flex-1 bars (.seg track rgba(246,241,227,0.22) + .seg-fill amber #f0b429) where one bar runs a .seg-anim fillbar keyframe (transform-origin left, scaleX 0 -> 1) over 5s linear, mapping to slide count and progress; reused on every showcase card with varying filled/empty counts

Left/right tap-to-advance zones: inset-y-0 w-1/3 z-10 zones that are opacity-0 hover:opacity-100, with a .tap-hint / .tap-hint-l amber-tinted directional gradient and a circular navy-900/50 backdrop-blur arrow button (solar:alt-arrow-left/right-linear) revealing on hover
Story meta row: an 'SF' amber avatar (ring-2 ring-cream/30) + a 'Storyframe' name + a '2 of 5 . 4s' slide-count/timer label, with a navy-900/40 backdrop-blur menu-dots button

Bottom caption block: a 'Chapter 02' amber/90 uppercase tag + a font-black 'The Golden Hour' title + a sub line + a cream 'Continue' button and a circular outlined bookmark button, over the layered navy gradients

Floating 'tap -> advance' accent card: a hidden-below-sm navy-800/90 backdrop-blur rounded-2xl card pinned -left-6 bottom-16 off the story card, with an amber solar:cursor-bold + a 'tap -> advance' label, lifted on .slide-shadow

story-carousel.prompt code card: a navy-800/80 backdrop-blur rounded-3xl .slide-shadow card with a header bar (an amber magic-stick icon + filename + an amber 'Copy prompt' button), a font-mono prompt body with amber highlight spans, and a tag row of four cream pills + an amber 'star 4.9 . 12k uses' rating chip

Full-bleed showcase story-card gallery: three aspect-[3/4] rounded-3xl .slide-shadow cards each a full-bleed group-hover:scale-105 photo under a navy gradient with its own segmented bars + a category tag + a caption

Bordered hairline-divider feature grid: a grid gap-px over a bg-cream/10 ground (rounded-3xl border border-cream/10 overflow-hidden) so the 1px gaps render as cream hairline dividers between six bg-navy-800 hover:bg-navy-700 tiles, each with an amber/15 rounded-2xl icon tile

Full-bleed gradient CTA panel: a from-navy-700 via-navy-800 to-navy-900 base with a centered amber/12 blur blob, a .grain overlay, an amber-highlighted font-black headline, and an amber-primary + outlined-cream button pair

Custom amber glow + cinematic shadow utilities: .glow-amber (an amber ring + amber drop) on the primary CTAs and .slide-shadow (a deep cinematic drop + a faint cream hairline) on the cards, plus a .grain SVG fractal-noise film texture and large blurred amber/navy decorative blobs
Sticky translucent navy nav (.bg-navy-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl with a cream/10 border) carrying an amber 'posts-carousel-vertical' brand tile + a 'Storyframe' wordmark and an amber 'Start free' pill

structured.special_notes: Built on the Tailwind CDN with a custom theme.extend: fontFamily.sans = ['Inter','sans-serif']; colors.navy { DEFAULT '#0b1f3a', 900 '#081627', 800 '#0b1f3a', 700 '#122e54', 600 '#1b3e6e' }, colors.cream { DEFAULT '#f6f1e3', soft '#e9e1cc', dim '#bcb4a0' }, colors.amber { DEFAULT '#f0b429', soft '#f8cf67', deep '#c98a12' }. Google Fonts: Inter (weights 400;500;600;700;800;900). CSS keys: html scroll-behavior smooth; body background #0b1f3a + color #f6f1e3 + font-sans + -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased + overflow-x-hidden. .grain { background-image an inline SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.9 numOctaves 3 opacity 0.5 } used at opacity ~0.04. .glow-amber { box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.25), 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(240,180,41,0.35) }. .slide-shadow { box-shadow 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(246,241,227,0.06) }. .seg { background rgba(246,241,227,0.22) }, .seg-fill { background #f0b429 }, .seg-anim { transform-origin left; animation fillbar 5s linear forwards } with @keyframes fillbar { from transform scaleX(0); to transform scaleX(1) }. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .seg-anim animation none; * scroll-behavior auto }. .tap-hint { background linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11,31,58,0) 0%, rgba(240,180,41,0.10) 100%) }, .tap-hint-l { the 270deg mirror }. .mask-fade { -webkit-mask-image linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 8%, #000 100%) }. ::selection { background #f0b429; color #081627 }. Navy #0b1f3a is the ground (a navy ramp 900 #081627 / 800 #0b1f3a / 700 #122e54 / 600 #1b3e6e), cream is the type ramp (cream #f6f1e3 / soft #e9e1cc / dim #bcb4a0), amber #f0b429 (soft #f8cf67 / deep #c98a12) is the single accent used on the brand mark, the headline highlight, primary buttons, progress-bar fills, category tags and icon accents; navy slide gradients (a vertical from-navy-900/95 via-navy-900/10 to-navy-900/40 + a horizontal from-navy-900/30 to-transparent) keep cream captions legible over every photo. Icons via Iconify Solar 'solar:*' set (posts-carousel-vertical-bold, arrow-right-linear, play-circle-bold, bolt-bold, hand-shake-bold, menu-dots-bold, alt-arrow-left-linear, alt-arrow-right-linear, bookmark-linear, cursor-bold, planet-bold, black-hole-bold, cardholder-bold, diploma-bold, atom-bold, magic-stick-3-bold, copy-bold, check-circle-bold, chart-2-bold, hand-stars-bold, full-screen-square-bold, smartphone-2-bold, accessibility-bold, code-square-bold) plus mdi:github / ri:twitter-x-fill / mdi:discord in the footer, loaded from https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js. Photos via Unsplash. The reusable prompt-library value is the FULLSCREEN STORY CAROUSEL pattern: a full-bleed phone-shaped story card with segmented progress bars across the top (one animating via a 5s fillbar keyframe, mapping to slide count), left/right tap-to-advance zones that reveal a circular arrow on hover, a story meta row (avatar + name + '2 of 5 . 4s'), and a bottom caption block (a chapter tag + title + sub line + a Continue/bookmark button row), all over layered navy gradients on the photo, plus a floating 'tap -> advance' accent card, wrapped into a complete one-screen cinematic 'Storyframe' landing (a sticky translucent navy nav, a two-column hero, a trust strip, a three-up full-bleed showcase gallery whose cards reuse the segmented-bars + tag + caption pattern, a full-bleed 'Prompt Library' section with a 'story-carousel.prompt' code card, a 6-up bordered 'Craft' feature grid, a full-bleed gradient CTA panel and a footer). Original prompt-library product for the placeholder brand 'Storyframe', a cinematic full-bleed Instagram/Stories-style story-carousel angle distinct from the warm multi-card 'Glide' sibling. Responsive: the hero grid stacks lg:grid-cols-2 -> one column, the story card scales w-[300px] -> sm:w-[340px] at a fixed 9/16 aspect (the floating accent card hidden below sm), the showcase gallery collapses lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column, the prompt-library lg:grid-cols-12 (5/7) -> one column, the craft grid lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column, the nav center links hide below md and 'Sign in' below sm, the headlines scale (hero text-[2.7rem] -> sm:text-6xl, sections text-3xl -> sm:text-4xl, CTA text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl), the CTA button row + footer switch flex-col -> sm:flex-row, the trust strip wraps, and the body is overflow-x-hidden so the blurred blobs never scroll; no horizontal overflow at 390px.
